names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 11 Αυγούστου, «Άγιοι Νεόφυτος, Ζήνων, Γάιος, Μάρκος, Μακάριος και Γαϊανός», with the rank word left off. The page gives him a head line of his own, «Αγιος Νεοφυτος», and glosses the name from νέος + φύομαι, «ο νεομυηθείς, ο αναγεννηθείς».

attestations.note: The first of the six the one listing line names, each with his own head line on the shared page, so it is a synaxis that enumerates its members and the members are folders. The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 11 Αυγούστου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. This folder closes a refusal the first reader of this day made: he drafted only Zenon, Mark and Macarius, and refused Neophytos, Gaius and Gaianos because the corpus already keeps `neophytus-5-may`, `gaius-5-may` and `gaianus-5-may` with `greek` rows venerated on 5 Μαΐου, saint.gr's «Άγιοι Νεόφυτος, Γάιος και Γαϊανός οι Μάρτυρες». That refusal was against the corpus's settled rule: two entries on one calendar are two commemorations, and so two men. The 5 May three are therefore other men, their rows are not touched, and this folder is surnamed with its own day so that it cannot be read as the 5 May man. saint.gr gives no year, no country and no relics, so there is no `dates` object. The page prints two distichs and no hymn. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
